task:
Integrate the Phase 12 transport core plus lifecycle (commits 4535b3d and 09b8ea3) with desktop Tauri/Rust authority and Android on branch feat/phase-12-android-companion. The shared JSON-line contract is b60bd0b and the ephemeral one-time key/connection shutdown API is 09b8ea3; use them instead of inventing new semantics.

Add an in-memory CompanionTransportManager/State around TransportHandle/EphemeralPairing. Add typed Rust request/status/result structures and Tauri commands for explicit Owner-confirmed start, stop, and status. Start must reject temporary chat/safe mode/invalid agent-owner, require ownerConfirmed=true, default bind 127.0.0.1, allow only explicitly confirmed RFC1918 host, reject wildcard/public, use bounded/ephemeral port, call the one-time pairing-key API, return raw pairing code only in the start result to the Owner/UI, and never log/persist it. Stop must use lifecycle shutdown; status must be redacted. Add AppState initialization, test_state field, command registration, and TypeScript contracts/invoke wrappers/Portuguese status UI.

Wire the callback to real Owner/agent Rust/SQLite companion authority. An authenticated `pair` frame with bounded JSON payload must call existing start_companion_pairing; after the Owner confirms pairing, `session`/`reconnect`, `history`, `queue_preview`, `queue_approve`, `queue_cancel`, and `queue_retry` frames must deserialize into existing request structs, carry the exact session proof/idempotency/temporaryChat fields, call existing Database methods, and return bounded typed JSON responses. Never fabricate effects or return raw private paths/media/secrets. Preserve all existing fixture commands/gates. Add a real Rust integration test with a temporary Database and actual localhost TCP client that performs auth/pair/session/history or queue request, rejects wrong MAC/replay/temporary chat/revocation, and proves stop closes the port.

Update Android SocketTransport to use the shared JSON-line WireFrame and SecureStore key: explicit connect only, pairing/session handshake, HMAC/replay checks, bounded history/queue requests, timeout/reconnect, and offline/degraded result when no desktop response. Add JVM tests against a deterministic loopback fake and offline fallback. Do not auto-connect, scan, or listen on Android.

Update docs/PHASE_12_ANDROID_IMPLEMENTATION.md, PHASE_12_ANDROID_SPEC.md, ROADMAP.md, KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md, CORRECTIVE_GAP_MATRIX.md, README.md honestly: real APK + authenticated local/private transport + deterministic loopback functional; physical-device/private-LAN/manual/release signing reservations; Phase 13 BielOS/Cloudflare remains separate. Run cargo fmt/check/clippy/full/focused tests; contracts typecheck/build/tests; desktop typecheck/tests/build; Android absolute-toolchain gradle test/lint/assembleDebug; APK SHA-256; secrets scan; diff check; clean status. Commit this integration exactly `feat: integrate phase 12 companion transport`. No push/publish/PR/merge/tag/release/deploy/BielOS/native subagents/direct edits.
constraints: Use only the configured Biel4 App Server Executor in fast mode; no native subagents or alternate backend.
Use the committed shared wire/lifecycle APIs; Rust/SQLite authority and raw-secret prohibition remain mandatory.
Transport must be explicit, authenticated, bounded, local/private-only by default, fail-closed, and no relay/public listener/telemetry/Python exposure.
Use absolute checkout-local Android toolchain paths; ignored .tooling is never committed.
No remote mutation, BielOS import, Phase 13 external integration, or release claim.

review_findings.title: Integration was previously blocked by missing lifecycle primitives
review_findings.details: The shared JSON contract and one-time pairing/shutdown lifecycle are now implemented and tested in b60bd0b/09b8ea3. Complete the Tauri/SQLite/Android integration against those APIs and verify real loopback effects.
